name: agent-reflex
description: Coding agent workflow optimization and safeguarding with any System One decision model. Ports the agent-reflex OpenCode plugin to Google Antigravity: a shell guardrail (hard block), post-edit syntax and bug checks, complexity classification, compaction guidance, and an on-demand confidence check. Classifier-driven effort and history pruning need the OpenCode plugin because Antigravity cannot rewrite model requests.
